## Problem

Two independent gaps make the live-Jira E2E tests' isolation story weaker than the code claims.

### (a) `xdist_group` is inert under the distribution mode a local full-suite run actually uses

`tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py:62-66` carries
`pytest.mark.xdist_group("live_reconcile_e2e")`, and the module docstring (lines ~57-61) states this
"pins every test in this module to a SINGLE pytest-xdist worker".

That is true **only under `--dist loadgroup`**. Verified against the installed xdist 3.8.0:
`xdist/scheduler/loadgroup.py:11-13` is the only scheduler that reads groups; `scheduler/load.py`
and `scheduler/worksteal.py` contain zero occurrences of `group`/`xdist_group`, and
`xdist/plugin.py:124` documents the mark as loadgroup-only.

CI passes `--dist loadgroup` for the integration tier (`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:663`),
so CI is fine. But `pyproject.toml:599` sets only `addopts = "--strict-markers --strict-config"` —
no `-n`, no `--dist` — so a local `pytest -n auto` (exactly the "full local xdist inventory" that
produced the d30c regression report) gets xdist's **default `--dist load`, where the group mark is
silently ignored**. The protection the docstring promises does not exist locally.

### (b) A second live-Jira test carries no group mark at all

`tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py:155-172` — `test_reconcile_dry_run_against_live_jira` — runs a
real `rebar reconcile` dry-run against live Jira whenever `acli` is on PATH and `JIRA_PROJECT` is
set. It has no `xdist_group` and no `pytestmark` (a repo-wide `xdist_group` grep returns only
`test_reconcile_live_e2e.py:65` and `test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py:334,348`). It can therefore
land on a different worker and issue a project-wide inbound JQL fetch concurrently with the
delete-permission probe's create+poll — under `loadgroup` **and** under `load`.

Note also that `test_delete_permission_probe` is the only `@_requires_live` test inside its own
module, so the intra-module grouping buys nothing on its own; the counterparty it needs to be
serialised against lives in a different file.

## Not the d30c root cause

d30c's failure was fully explained and fixed without any load term (the poll's per-JQL memo made it
a single-shot check). This ticket is the separately-observed isolation gap, filed so it is not lost.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Either pin the distribution mode so `xdist_group` is honoured wherever the live tests can run
  (e.g. set `--dist loadgroup` in `pyproject.toml` addopts), or correct the module docstring so it
  no longer claims protection that only holds in CI.
- [x] Put `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py::test_reconcile_dry_run_against_live_jira` in the
  same xdist group as the live reconciler E2E module, so all live-Jira traffic serialises.
- [x] A test or guard that fails if a new live-Jira-touching test is added without the group mark.
